sources.title: Beyond Disability coordination and projected opportunities

records.title: Facilitating inclusion in SMEDAN business training
records.dateBasis: Publication date; activity described as preceding Friday.
records.role: Office facilitated inclusion, according to an office statement.
records.limitations: Training and kits concern one cohort, not two beneficiary totals. Subsequent income and employment were not measured.

measures.population: PWD participants in this training and startup-support activity
measures.evidence: Article reports five PWD participants and attributes their inclusion to the office.

records.title: Reported employment placements in Borno
records.dateBasis: Retrospective anniversary account; event date unverified.
records.role: Office claims employment followed its engagement with the governor.
records.limitations: Office-reported attribution; employment records and retention not independently verified. Not a claim that Isa alone created these jobs.

measures.population: PWDs reportedly employed by Borno State after engagement
measures.evidence: Anniversary account, section 4, reports 15 PWDs employed after engagement with the governor.

records.title: Reported startup support and POS equipment
records.dateBasis: Anniversary account refers to March; exact day unverified.
records.role: Office reports startup support with partner organisations.
deliveryPartners: Partners not named in this passage
records.limitations: Individual packages, monetary total and overlap with other programmes are not established.

measures.population: PWD recipients in the March startup-support activity
measures.evidence: Anniversary account, section 4, reports more than 20 recipients of equipment, cash or startup kits.

records.title: Reported skills training for women with disabilities
records.dateBasis: Retrospective anniversary account; event date unverified.
records.role: Office reports partnering with NIGWED on reusable-pad production training.
records.limitations: Participant roster and completion criteria not verified. No employment or income outcome inferred. Nearby farming initiative is not assigned this count.

measures.population: Women with disabilities in reusable sanitary-pad training
measures.evidence: Anniversary account, section 5, reports more than 45 women trained and supported.

records.title: Beyond Disability coordination and jobs ambition
records.dateBasis: Publication date; exact orientation date not encoded.
records.role: Office initiative; coordinator documentation and orientation reported.
records.limitations: Projected opportunities, not delivered employment. Coordinator appointments do not verify all projected posts or participant outcomes.

measures.evidence: Article describes this as the programme objective and potential during implementation.

records.role: Advocate at a hearing; legislator Abdullahi el-Rasheed sponsored the bill.
